items.question: May a mantra-practitioner live in the house with annual first-day great rising?
items.inference: The verse permits annual household residence with first-day great rising.
uncertainties: fused final token not split; exact ritual sense of ādyāmahodayaḥ uncertain
items.plain_english: Or the mantra-practitioner may live in the house annually, with the first-day great rising.
